1
Dud. The light source 
(even a magical one) 
goes out and needs to 
be replaced or recast. 
2
Fire. The light source 
(even a magical one) 
flares and burns your 
hand. Take 1 damage. 
DC 18 DEX or drop it.
3
Air. A rogue wind or 
pocket of thin air blows 
through. DC 15 DEX or

4

shower or dripping 
ceiling hits the light

5
Earth. Falling rocks, 
mud, leaves, or ash 
cover the light source.

source is open flame, it
